title: LeanPlan: Optimal Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics and Admissibility Proofs
title_zh: LeanPlan：基于 LLM 生成的启发式函数与可采纳性证明的最优规划

paragraphs.en: Frontier large language models (LLMs) can generate heuristic functions that guide search to achieve state-of-the-art performance in satisficing planning, where any plan is acceptable. However, these heuristics are not guaranteed to be admissible and can lead to suboptimal plans. We introduce LeanPlan, the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. Given a domain description and training tasks, an agentic loop uses planner feedback to iteratively improve a reusable domain-specific heuristic, its admissibility proof and the required domain assumptions. LeanPlan implements the heuristic, its proof and an efficient planner with machine-checked grounding and search in Lean 4. We evaluate LeanPlan on ten domains from the International Planning Competition and three new domains, using test tasks with up to 57 times as many objects as the training tasks. With GPT-5.6 Sol in the agentic loop, we successfully generate heuristics and admissibility proofs for all these domains. With the resulting heuristics, LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art Scorpion planner and solves more tasks overall.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿大语言模型（LLM）能够生成启发式函数，引导搜索过程，从而在“满意规划”中实现当前最优性能——在此类规划中，任何可行的计划均可接受。 然而，这些启发式函数并不保证是可接纳的，并可能导致次优计划。 我们提出了 LeanPlan：首个利用 LLM 生成的启发式函数（其可接纳性经过机器验证）来寻找最优计划的规划系统。 给定一个领域描述和训练任务，智能体循环会利用规划器的反馈，迭代改进一个可重用的领域特定启发式函数、其可接纳性证明以及所需的领域假设。 LeanPlan 在 Lean 4 中实现了该启发式函数、其证明以及一个具备机器验证基础与搜索能力的高效规划器。 我们在国际规划竞赛提供的十个领域和三个新领域上对 LeanPlan 进行了评估，测试任务中的对象数量最多可达训练任务的 57 倍。 在智能体循环中使用 GPT-5.6 Sol，我们成功为所有这些领域生成了启发式函数和可接纳性证明。 利用这些生成的启发式函数，LeanPlan 通常比当前最优的 Scorpion 规划器扩展更少的状态，并且总体上能解决更多任务。

paragraphs.en: Classical planning asks for a sequence of actions that transforms an initial state into a state that satisfies a goal Ghallab et al. (2004) . Planning tasks come in domains , families of tasks with the same kinds of objects and actions, such as stacking blocks or moving a lift between floors. Domains and tasks are usually described in the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) Haslum et al. (2019) . Heuristic search is one of the most successful approaches to classical planning Bonet & Geffner (2001) ; Hoffmann & Nebel (2001) . A heuristic estimates the cost of reaching a goal from a state, and the search uses these estimates to decide which states to explore next Pearl (1984) . Domain-independent heuristics derive their estimates from the task description alone and therefore apply to any task. Domain-specific heuristics exploit knowledge about a particular domain and can be much more informative Junghanns & Schaeffer (2001) , but a human expert usually has to design and implement each of them.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we study a complementary approach: generating the heuristic program together with a proof of its admissibility. We introduce LeanPlan , the first planning system that finds optimal plans with LLM-generated heuristics whose admissibility is machine-checked. LeanPlan implements each domain heuristic and its proof in Lean 4 de Moura & Ullrich (2021) , a programming language and proof assistant, so that Lean’s kernel checks the proof. The heuristic can be any Lean program, for example one that combines domain-specific action counts, distance bounds and dead-end tests, as long as its admissibility can be proved. Because the proof is about the code that the planner actually runs, there is no separate implementation that could deviate from the verified one. Shared proofs, which apply to all domains, turn each admissibility proof into an optimality guarantee for the plans that the planner returns. Unlike a statistical generalization bound, the proof covers every task of the domain that satisfies its checked assumptions, however large, and not only the training tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了一种互补的方法：同时生成启发式程序及其可采纳性的证明。 我们提出了 LeanPlan——首个能够利用大语言模型生成的启发式方法找到最优规划方案的系统，且这些启发式方法的可采纳性经过机器验证。 LeanPlan 在 Lean 4 de Moura & Ullrich (2021)（一种编程语言兼证明辅助工具）中实现了每个领域的启发式方法及其证明，从而让 Lean 的核心验证系统能够检查该证明。 这种启发式方法可以是任何 Lean 程序，例如结合领域特定动作计数、距离界限和死胡同检测的程序，只要其可采纳性能够被证明即可。 由于该证明针对的是规划器实际运行的代码本身，因此不存在可能偏离已验证版本的独立实现。 共享证明适用于所有领域，它将每个可采纳性证明转化为规划器所返回方案的最优性保证。 与统计泛化界限不同，该证明涵盖了领域中满足其已验证假设的所有任务（无论规模多大），而不仅仅是训练任务。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 shows how LeanPlan develops and uses a heuristic. A deterministic generator first translates the PDDL domain into a Lean module, which fixes the vocabulary available to the heuristic and its proof. Given this module, the domain’s training tasks and a shared proof library, an LLM coding agent writes the heuristic, its admissibility proof and Boolean checks of the domain assumptions that the proof relies on. The agent builds the code and runs the planner itself, uses failures as feedback and revises the artifacts until it judges that it cannot improve the heuristic further. Whether the proof is correct is decided by Lean’s kernel, a small trusted proof checker, and not by the agent’s own report of success. An accepted heuristic then serves A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} on new tasks of the domain, without further LLM calls or new proofs.
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了 LeanPlan 如何开发和使用启发式方法。 一个确定性生成器首先将 PDDL 域转换为 Lean 模块，该模块确定了启发式方法及其证明可用的词汇表。 给定该模块、域的训练任务以及共享的证明库，一个 LLM 编码智能体将编写启发式方法、其可接受性证明，以及对域假设的布尔检查（这些假设是证明所依赖的）。 该智能体构建代码并自行运行规划器，将失败作为反馈，并不断修订相关成果，直到判断无法进一步改进启发式方法为止。 证明是否正确由 Lean 的核心——一个小型可信的证明检查器——决定，而非由智能体自身报告的成功状态决定。 被接受的启发式方法随后会在域的新任务上运行 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*}，而无需再次调用 LLM 或生成新的证明。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate LeanPlan on 900 test tasks from ten domains of the Learning Track of the 2023 International Planning Competition (IPC) Taitler et al. (2024) and on 270 test tasks from three new domains. The new domains were not publicly available before our experiments, which rules out exposure through public LLM training data. In IPC 2023, the hard test tasks have 2.5 to 57 times as many objects as the largest training task of their domain, compared with at most about twice as many in the new domains. With GPT-5.6 Sol as the coding agent, LeanPlan obtains an admissible heuristic with a machine-checked proof for all thirteen domains. With the generated heuristics, LeanPlan solves 281 IPC 2023 tasks and 67 new-domain tasks, 27.1% and 31.4% more than the state-of-the-art optimal planner Scorpion Seipp (2024) , which solves 221 and 51 tasks. A planner with machine-checked optimality guarantees can thus outperform a state-of-the-art, domain-independent optimal planner that offers no such guarantees.

paragraphs.en: Lean 4 combines a functional programming language with an interactive theorem prover de Moura & Ullrich (2021) . Its type system expresses both executable functions and logical statements about them. For example, a function from natural numbers to natural numbers has type Nat -> Nat , while the proposition forall n : Nat, n + 0 = n has type Prop , the type of propositions. Because programs and propositions share one language, a theorem can refer directly to the definition of a total function (one that terminates on every input), including its arithmetic, case distinctions and recursive calls. A proof of a proposition is a proof term whose type is that proposition. Lean’s kernel , a small checker for Lean’s core logic, verifies that the term has the claimed type, using only the declared definitions and axioms.
paragraphs.zh: Lean 4 将函数式编程语言与交互式定理证明器相结合 de Moura & Ullrich (2021) 。 其类型系统既能表示可执行的函数，也能表示关于这些函数的逻辑陈述。 例如，一个从自然数到自然数的函数具有类型 Nat -> Nat ，而命题 forall n : Nat, n + 0 = n 的类型是 Prop ，即命题的类型。 由于程序和命题共享同一种语言，定理可以直接引用一个全函数（对每个输入都会终止的函数）的定义，包括其算术运算、情况区分和递归调用。 对一个命题的证明是一个证明项，其类型正是该命题本身。 Lean 的核心引擎——一个用于检查 Lean 核心逻辑的小型验证器——仅使用已声明的定义和公理，来验证该证明项是否具有所声称的类型。

sents.zh: 其类型系统既能表示可执行的函数，也能表示关于这些函数的逻辑陈述。

sents.en: For example, a function from natural numbers to natural numbers has type Nat -> Nat , while the proposition forall n : Nat, n + 0 = n has type Prop , the type of propositions.
sents.zh: 例如，一个从自然数到自然数的函数具有类型 Nat -> Nat ，而命题 forall n : Nat, n + 0 = n 的类型是 Prop ，即命题的类型。

sents.en: Because programs and propositions share one language, a theorem can refer directly to the definition of a total function (one that terminates on every input), including its arithmetic, case distinctions and recursive calls.
sents.zh: 由于程序和命题共享同一种语言，定理可以直接引用一个全函数（对每个输入都会终止的函数）的定义，包括其算术运算、情况区分和递归调用。

sents.en: A proof of a proposition is a proof term whose type is that proposition.
sents.zh: 对一个命题的证明是一个证明项，其类型正是该命题本身。

sents.en: Lean’s kernel , a small checker for Lean’s core logic, verifies that the term has the claimed type, using only the declared definitions and axioms.
sents.zh: Lean 的核心引擎——一个用于检查 Lean 核心逻辑的小型验证器——仅使用已声明的定义和公理，来验证该证明项是否具有所声称的类型。

paragraphs.en: Proof terms are usually constructed with tactics instead of being written directly. A proof goal consists of a proposition to establish and the local assumptions available for proving it. A tactic transforms a proof goal into zero or more simpler goals while building the corresponding proof term, for example by unfolding definitions, applying existing lemmas, splitting cases, performing induction or solving arithmetic subgoals. The proof is complete when no goals remain. The kernel then checks the resulting term independently of how it was constructed, so trusting a proof requires trusting only the kernel and the axioms.
paragraphs.zh: 证明项通常通过策略构建，而不是直接编写。 一个证明目标包括一个需要确立的命题以及可用于证明该命题的局部假设。 一种策略会将一个证明目标转化为零个或多个更简单的目标，同时构建相应的证明项，例如通过展开定义、应用现有引理、拆分情况、执行归纳或解决算术子目标。 当没有剩余目标时，证明即告完成。 随后，内核将独立于其构建方式检查结果项，因此信任一个证明只需信任内核和公理。

paragraphs.en: A theorem holds for all values of its parameters that satisfy its assumptions. A theorem about all natural numbers thus covers infinitely many values, not only those in a finite test set. Likewise, LeanPlan’s domain theorems cover every task that satisfies their assumptions (Section 3 ), not only the training tasks. Theorems are separate declarations that the compiled planner never executes, so the proofs add no runtime cost. Figure 2 in Section 4 shows a small example of a function, a theorem about it and a tactic proof.

paragraphs.en: A heuristic may rely on properties of a domain’s tasks that PDDL does not enforce. For example, a Blocksworld heuristic may assume that at most one block is directly on top of each block. This property holds in every Blocksworld task of interest, but a syntactically valid task can violate it. Following Abdulaziz et al. (2022) , we make such properties explicit as domain assumptions , which are Boolean checks on the task’s objects, initial state and goal. The agent that develops the heuristic is free to choose the domain assumptions that its proof needs, as long as all training tasks satisfy them. We call the collection of a heuristic’s domain assumptions its certificate . The certificate also checks that the input domain has exactly the action schemas of the generated Lean module, since the proof reasons about these schemas. LeanPlan evaluates the certificate before search and refuses to use the heuristic on a task that fails any of the certificate’s checks. 1 1 1 These checks revealed a bug in the IPC 2023 Learning Track training set: the initial state of Floortile task p08.pddl contains both (robot-at robot2 tile_2_1) and (clear tile_2_1) , so another robot can move onto the occupied tile. We reported the bug to the competition organizers, and it has since been fixed in the benchmark repository.
paragraphs.zh: 启发式方法可能依赖于某个领域任务中 PDDL 并未强制执行的某些属性。例如，Blocksworld 启发式方法可以假设每个方块上最多只有一个方块直接叠放。这一属性在所有我们关注的 Blocksworld 任务中都成立，但一个在语法上有效的任务可能违反它。遵循 Abdulaziz 等人（2022）的做法，我们将此类属性明确表述为领域假设，即对任务中的对象、初始状态和目标的布尔检查。开发启发式方法的智能体可以自由选择其证明所需的领域假设，只要所有训练任务都满足这些假设即可。我们将某个启发式方法的所有领域假设集合称为其证书。该证书还会检查输入领域是否恰好包含所生成的 Lean 模块中的动作模式，因为证明过程正是基于这些模式进行推理的。LeanPlan 会在搜索前评估证书，如果某个任务未能通过证书的任意一项检查，它将拒绝在该任务上使用此启发式方法。1 1 1 这些检查揭示了 IPC 2023 学习赛道训练集中存在的一个错误：Floortile 任务 p08.pddl 的初始状态同时包含了 (robot-at robot2 tile_2_1) 和 (clear tile_2_1)，因此另一个机器人可以移动到已被占用的方块上。我们已向竞赛组织方报告了这一错误，此后该问题已在基准测试仓库中修复。

paragraphs.en: Since the agent’s own report of success is not evidence, an automated controller re-checks the files the agent leaves behind. It rejects the candidate if these files declare a new axiom or use one of the Lean constructs sorry , admit and native_decide , which skip a proof or trust unverified code. It then rebuilds the generated Lean module, the proofs and the planner, and it checks that the domain theorems depend only on Lean’s standard axioms and that the certificate accepts every training task. Finally, it runs the planner on the training tasks. The controller accepts the heuristic only if all checks pass and A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} with it solves at least as many training tasks as Scorpion Seipp (2024) , while expanding strictly fewer states in total on the tasks both solve. This comparison requires a nonempty shared set with complete expansion counts, even when LeanPlan solves more tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 由于智能体自身对成功的报告并非证据，自动化控制器会重新检查智能体留下的文件。 如果这些文件中声明了新的公理，或使用了 Lean 中的 sorry、admit 和 native_decide 等构造（这些构造会跳过证明或信任未经验证的代码），控制器就会拒绝该候选方案。 接着，它会重建生成的 Lean 模块、证明和规划器，并检查域定理是否仅依赖于 Lean 的标准公理，以及证书是否接受所有训练任务。 最后，它会在训练任务上运行规划器。 只有当所有检查均通过，且使用 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} 的规划器在两者共同解决的任务上，至少能解决与 Scorpion Seipp (2024) 同样数量的任务，同时总状态扩展数严格更少时，控制器才会接受该启发式方法。 即使 LeanPlan 解决了更多任务，这种比较也需要一个非空的共享集合以及完整的状态扩展计数。

paragraphs.en: To solve a new task, LeanPlan parses and validates it, grounds it and, if the task passes the certificate, runs A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} with the heuristic. Grounding is similar to the algorithm by Helmert (2009) , which is used in popular planners such as Fast Downward Helmert (2006) and Scorpion Seipp (2024) , the state-of-the-art optimal planner that extends Fast Downward. Grounding instantiates only actions whose static preconditions, which no action can change, hold in the initial state. LeanPlan then prunes actions that h 2 h^{2} mutexes rule out Alcázar & Torralba (2015) and removes effects and actions that cannot influence the goal.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决一个新任务，LeanPlan 会先解析并验证该任务，然后对其执行 grounding；如果该任务通过验证，就会使用启发式函数运行 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*}。 Grounding 的方法与 Helmert（2009）提出的算法类似，该算法被用于 Fast Downward Helmert（2006）和 Scorpion Seipp（2024）等主流规划器；后者是目前最先进的最优规划器，在 Fast Downward 的基础上进行了扩展。 Grounding 仅会实例化那些静态前提条件在初始状态中成立且无法被任何行动改变的行动。 随后，LeanPlan 会根据 h 2 h^{2} 互斥关系排除某些行动（Alcázar & Torralba, 2015），并移除那些无法影响目标的效果和行动。

paragraphs.en: LeanPlan’s A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} is a standard implementation with duplicate detection, reopening and goal tests at expansion time. Like Scorpion, it breaks ties between states with the same sum of path cost and heuristic value in favor of lower heuristic values Asai & Fukunaga (2017) . Unlike Scorpion, it then prefers the most recently added state, which tends to be more efficient Asai & Fukunaga (2016) .
paragraphs.zh: LeanPlan 的 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} 是一种标准实现，在扩展时会进行重复检测、重新打开和目标测试。 与 Scorpion 类似，当状态的路径成本与启发式值之和相同时，它会优先选择启发式值较低的状态 Asai & Fukunaga (2017) 。 但与 Scorpion 不同，它随后会优先选择最近添加的状态，这通常效率更高 Asai & Fukunaga (2016) 。

sents.en: LeanPlan’s A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} is a standard implementation with duplicate detection, reopening and goal tests at expansion time.
sents.zh: LeanPlan 的 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} 是一种标准实现，在扩展时会进行重复检测、重新打开和目标测试。

sents.en: Like Scorpion, it breaks ties between states with the same sum of path cost and heuristic value in favor of lower heuristic values Asai & Fukunaga (2017) .
sents.zh: 与 Scorpion 类似，当状态的路径成本与启发式值之和相同时，它会优先选择启发式值较低的状态 Asai & Fukunaga (2017) 。

sents.en: Unlike Scorpion, it then prefers the most recently added state, which tends to be more efficient Asai & Fukunaga (2016) .
sents.zh: 但与 Scorpion 不同，它随后会优先选择最近添加的状态，这通常效率更高 Asai & Fukunaga (2016) 。

paragraphs.en: Shared theorems extend the domain guarantees from the heuristic to the whole search. Every plan that A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} returns is valid for the ground task, and with an admissible, goal-aware heuristic, it is optimal whenever it costs less than a large bound B B , far above the cost of any plan in our experiments. Since heuristics in Lean return natural numbers, LeanPlan represents ∞ \infty by B B and prunes every state whose heuristic value reaches it. The proofs therefore certify optimal plans but not dead ends or unsolvable tasks, and Appendix B states the theorems and explains this limitation.
paragraphs.zh: 共享定理将域保证从启发式方法扩展到整个搜索过程。 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} 返回的每个计划对于基础任务都是有效的；如果启发式方法是可采纳且目标感知的，那么只要其成本低于一个较大的界限 B B（该界限远高于我们实验中任何计划的成本），该计划就是最优的。 由于 Lean 中的启发式方法返回的是自然数，LeanPlan 用 B B 表示 ∞ \infty，并剪枝所有启发式值达到该值的状态。 因此，这些证明可以认证最优计划，但无法识别死胡同或不可解的任务；附录 B 陈述了这些定理并解释了这一局限性。

The heuristic considers only passengers whose served goal is unmet, and it lets W ⁡ ( s ) W(s) contain those still waiting and R ⁡ ( s ) R(s) those aboard. Let F ⁡ ( s ) F(s) be the set of their destination floors and the origin floors of W ⁡ ( s ) W(s) , excluding the current lift floor, so that a floor needed by several passengers counts once. The resulting heuristic is 2 ​ | W ⁡ ( s ) | + | R ⁡ ( s ) | + | F ⁡ ( s ) | 2|W(s)|+|R(s)|+|F(s)| . A move reaches at most one required floor, and boarding or leaving reduces the passenger term 2 ​ | W ⁡ ( s ) | + | R ⁡ ( s ) | 2|W(s)|+|R(s)| by exactly one without reducing F ⁡ ( s ) F(s) , since it happens at the current floor, which F ⁡ ( s ) F(s) excludes. paragraphs.en: In this Sokoban formulation, each goal requires a specific box on a designated square. The heuristic is the maximum of two lower bounds that both ignore the other boxes when moving a box. Both use the push graph, which connects two squares if a box can be pushed from one to the other while the robot stands behind the box. The first bound adds up pushes and walking. For each box b b with an unmet goal, let P b ​ ( s ) P_{b}(s) count the pushes on a shortest path to its square in the push graph. Since each push moves only one box, different boxes need different pushes, so the sum of these counts is a lower bound on the number of pushes. Before its first push, the robot must also walk to a square from which it can push some box, and A ⁡ ( s ) A(s) is the length of the shortest such walk. Since the first push may move a box that is already at its goal, A ⁡ ( s ) A(s) also considers such boxes. The second bound considers each box on its own, with J b ​ ( s ) J_{b}(s) counting the robot moves and pushes on a shortest path that brings b b to its square when only b b and the robot remain. The two bounds may count the same actions, so the heuristic takes their maximum instead of their sum:

paragraphs.en: We use the ten domains from the IPC 2023 Learning Track Taitler et al. (2024) and three new domains, Orrery, Cisterns and Qubit Routing, described in Appendix C . The new domains and their tasks were not publicly available before the experiments, so the LLM cannot have seen them in public training data. Each domain has 90 test tasks, for 900 IPC 2023 tasks and 270 tasks in the new domains. The heuristics are developed on each domain’s training tasks, 89 to 99 per IPC 2023 domain and 20 per new domain. We run GPT-5.6 Sol at its highest reasoning effort as the coding agent in the Codex harness to generate heuristics and prove their admissibility. The agent runs in a sandbox that prevents access to the test tasks and restricts file modifications to the designated workspace.

The agent tries 10.3 heuristic variants per domain on average and at most 13. paragraphs.en: We compare five planner configurations. Two use LeanPlan: blind LeanPlan with the blind heuristic (0 at goal states and 1 elsewhere) and LeanPlan with the generated heuristics. The other three use the state-of-the-art optimal planner Scorpion Seipp (2024) : blind Scorpion with the blind heuristic, LM-cut with the domain-independent LM-cut heuristic Helmert & Domshlak (2009) and SCP with Scorpion’s recommended configuration. SCP combines abstraction heuristics via saturated cost partitioning Seipp et al. (2020) , and we adjust its component budgets to our resource limit. 2 2 2 The recommended Scorpion configuration allocates up to 100 seconds to systematic pattern collection construction, with 10 seconds per restart, and 1 000 seconds to online cost partitioning. We keep the per-restart limit and use 10 and 150 seconds for the other two budgets, which gave the best coverage in earlier parameter sweeps on the test suite under our 300-second overall limit. During heuristic development, the agentic loop gives both planners 30 seconds per training task and lowers all three budgets to 1, 1 and 15 seconds (Appendix F ). All five read the same PDDL inputs and run A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} after pruning actions that h 2 h^{2} mutexes rule out Alcázar & Torralba (2015) . We run each configuration once per task with Downward Lab Seipp et al. (2017) , limiting every run to 300 CPU seconds and 8 GiB of memory. We report coverage , the number of tasks solved, as well as planner time and the number of states expanded during search. The plan validator VAL Howey & Long (2003) accepts every returned plan, and all planners that solve a task find plans of the same cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了五种规划器配置。其中两种使用 LeanPlan：一种是采用盲目启发式（目标状态为 0，其他状态为 1）的盲目 LeanPlan，另一种是使用生成启发式的 LeanPlan。其余三种则采用了当前最先进的最优规划器 Scorpion Seipp (2024)：采用盲目启发式的盲目 Scorpion、使用领域无关 LM-cut 启发式（Helmert & Domshlak, 2009）的 LM-cut，以及采用 Scorpion 推荐配置的 SCP。SCP 通过饱和成本划分（Seipp et al., 2020）结合抽象启发式，我们将其各组件的预算调整至符合我们的资源限制。2 2 2 Scorpion 的推荐配置为系统性模式收集构建分配最多 100 秒，每次重启分配 10 秒，在线成本划分分配 1,000 秒。我们保留了每次重启的限制，并将另外两个预算分别设为 10 秒和 150 秒；在先前于测试套件上进行的参数扫描中，这一设置在 300 秒的总限制下实现了最佳覆盖度。在启发式开发阶段，智能体循环为两种规划器各分配了每次训练任务 30 秒，并将三个预算均降至 1、1 和 15 秒（附录 F）。五种规划器均读取相同的 PDDL 输入，并在剪除 h² 互斥规则排除的动作后运行 A*（Alcázar & Torralba, 2015）。我们使用 Downward Lab Seipp et al. (2017) 对每种配置在每个任务上运行一次，每次运行限制为 300 CPU 秒和 8 GiB 内存。我们报告了覆盖度（即已解决的任务数量），以及规划器运行时间和搜索过程中扩展的状态数。计划验证器 VAL Howey & Long (2003) 接受所有返回的计划，且所有成功解决某项任务的规划器都找到了成本相同的计划。

paragraphs.en: Since the blind heuristic gives no guidance, comparing blind LeanPlan with blind Scorpion measures how efficiently the two planners implement grounding and search. Blind LeanPlan solves nearly as many tasks as blind Scorpion (Table 1 ). The two planners solve the same number of tasks in all domains except Rovers and Cisterns, and every task solved by blind LeanPlan is also solved by blind Scorpion. On the IPC 2023 tasks that both solve, they expand almost the same number of states in total (differences are due to tie-breaking), but LeanPlan’s search takes about 1.5 times as long. The remaining gap therefore stems from slower state expansion rather than from different search behavior. Slower expansion also explains why blind LeanPlan solves fewer tasks within one second (106 compared to 116), although it nearly catches up within ten seconds (138 compared to 139). Overall, proof-checked grounding and search cost little coverage compared with Scorpion, whose Fast Downward code base Helmert (2006) has been optimized for many years.
paragraphs.zh: 由于盲目启发式方法不提供任何指导，因此将盲目 LeanPlan 与盲目 Scorpion 进行比较，可以衡量这两种规划器在执行 grounding 和搜索时的效率。 盲目 LeanPlan 解决的问题数量几乎与盲目 Scorpion 相当（表 1）。 除了 Rovers 和 Cisterns 领域外，这两种规划器在所有领域中都解决了相同数量的问题，并且盲目 LeanPlan 解决的每个问题也都被盲目 Scorpion 解决。 在两者都能解决的 IPC 2023 任务中，它们总共扩展的状态数量几乎相同（差异源于打破平局的处理方式），但 LeanPlan 的搜索时间大约长 1.5 倍。 因此，剩余的差距源于较慢的状态扩展，而非不同的搜索行为。 较慢的扩展也解释了为何盲目 LeanPlan 在一秒内解决的问题较少（106 个，而 Scorpion 为 116 个），尽管在十秒内它几乎追上了（138 个，而 Scorpion 为 139 个）。 总体而言，经过证明检查的 grounding 和搜索与 Scorpion 相比所消耗的覆盖资源很少，而 Scorpion 的 Fast Downward 代码库（Helmert, 2006）已经经过多年优化。

paragraphs.en: With the generated heuristics, LeanPlan solves the most IPC 2023 tasks (Table 1 ). LeanPlan’s advantage is largest on tasks beyond the training sizes. Of the 595 IPC 2023 test tasks with more objects than every training task of their domain, LeanPlan solves 53, compared to 13 for SCP, 7 for LM-cut and 0 for blind search. The generated heuristics thus remain effective far outside the training distribution.

paragraphs.en: The left panel of Figure 3 shows how quickly each configuration solves tasks. LeanPlan and LM-cut need little precomputation, so their curves rise from the start. LM-cut’s curve flattens early, however, because its heuristic is expensive to evaluate: on the tasks that both solve, LM-cut’s search takes five times as long as LeanPlan’s. SCP first spends up to ten seconds constructing its pattern collection, so its curve rises only afterwards. Within ten seconds, LeanPlan solves more tasks than SCP within the full time limit.

paragraphs.en: The right panel of Figure 3 compares the expansions of LeanPlan and SCP on the 211 IPC 2023 tasks that both solve. LeanPlan expands fewer states on 152 of these tasks and more on 55, and the balance depends on the domain. In Spanner, where LeanPlan’s heuristic prunes dead ends, LeanPlan expands fewer states on every task. In Sokoban, SCP expands fewer states on most tasks, presumably because its abstractions capture some interactions between boxes, which LeanPlan’s relaxations ignore. Since the planners also differ in other components, such as tie-breaking, these counts compare complete configurations rather than heuristics alone. Compared with blind LeanPlan, the generated heuristics reduce the number of expansions on every task that both solve, by more than two orders of magnitude in total.
paragraphs.zh: 图3的右侧面板比较了LeanPlan和SCP在两者都能解决的211个IPC 2023任务上的状态扩展次数。 在这些任务中，LeanPlan在152个任务上扩展的状态更少，在55个任务上更多，而具体平衡取决于任务领域。 在Spanner中，由于LeanPlan的启发式方法会剪枝死胡同，因此它在所有任务上的状态扩展次数都更少。 在Sokoban中，SCP在大多数任务上的状态扩展次数更少，这可能是因为其抽象方法捕捉到了箱子之间的某些相互作用，而LeanPlan的松弛方法忽略了这些相互作用。 由于这两种规划器在其他组件（例如打破平局的方法）上也存在差异，因此这些扩展次数比较的是完整的配置，而非仅比较启发式方法本身。 与无启发式的LeanPlan相比，生成的启发式方法在两者都能解决的每个任务上都减少了状态扩展次数，总减少量超过两个数量级。

paragraphs.en: In the new domains, blind search solves only a few Cisterns tasks, and LM-cut solves few tasks in any domain. There, the certificate refuses three test tasks, the only refusals among all 1 170 test tasks, so the proof does not cover them and LeanPlan counts them as unsolved. SCP solves one of them, which accounts for its lead. No configuration solves the other two. Since the certificate must accept all training tasks, a more varied training set could have led the controller to reject this heuristic and the agent to find one that also covers such tasks.

paragraphs.en: Plan validators such as VAL Howey & Long (2003) check plans, Abdulaziz & Lammich (2018) formally verify such a validator in Isabelle/HOL Nipkow et al. (2002) and Abdulaziz & Kurz (2023) formally verify a SAT-based planner. Certifying algorithms McConnell et al. (2011) return a certificate that an independent checker can verify, and certifying planners provide such certificates for unsolvability Eriksson et al. (2017) ; Eriksson et al. (2018) and optimality Mugdan et al. (2023) ; Dold et al. (2025) . Dold et al. (2025) extend A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} to emit pseudo-Boolean certificates of optimality during the search, which the independent proof checker VeriPB then validates. These certificates are generated and checked for each task, whereas LeanPlan proves admissibility once per domain. What we call a certificate (Section 3 ) is therefore not a per-task proof, but a fixed set of Boolean checks that establishes the premise of the domain theorems for each task. Closest to our work, Abdulaziz et al. (2022) use Isabelle/HOL to prove for Miconic that a generalized potential heuristic Francès et al. (2019) is descending on all tasks. Behnke et al. (2026) formalize A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} and standard planning heuristics in Lean, using LLM-generated proofs for several components. LeanPlan instead targets admissibility of generated domain-specific heuristics, and LLM coding agents construct their proofs without human interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 像 VAL Howey & Long (2003) 这样的规划验证器会检查规划方案；Abdulaziz & Lammich (2018) 在 Isabelle/HOL Nipkow et al. (2002) 中对该类验证器进行了形式化验证，而 Abdulaziz & Kurz (2023) 则对一种基于 SAT 的规划器进行了形式化验证。认证算法 McConnell et al. (2011) 会返回一个证书，供独立检查器进行验证；认证规划器则为不可解性提供此类证书 Eriksson et al. (2017)；Eriksson et al. (2018)，并为最优性提供证书 Mugdan et al. (2023)；Dold et al. (2025)。Dold et al. (2025) 扩展了 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*}，使其在搜索过程中能够输出最优性的伪布尔证书，随后由独立证明检查器 VeriPB 进行验证。这些证书是针对每个任务生成和检查的，而 LeanPlan 则只需在每个领域中证明一次可采纳性。因此，我们所说的“证书”（第 3 节）并非针对每个任务的证明，而是一组固定的布尔检查，用于为每个任务确立领域定理的前提。与我们工作最接近的是 Abdulaziz et al. (2022)，他们使用 Isabelle/HOL 证明了 Miconic 领域中一种广义势启发式 Francès et al. (2019) 在所有任务上都是递减的。Behnke et al. (2026) 在 Lean 中形式化了 A ∗ \mathrm{A}^{*} 和标准规划启发式，并使用 LLM 生成的证明来验证多个组件。相比之下，LeanPlan 的目标是证明所生成领域特定启发式的可采纳性，并且其 LLM 编码智能体无需人类干预即可自行构建证明。

paragraphs.en: LLMs increasingly construct proofs in interactive theorem provers such as Lean and Isabelle Jiang et al. (2023) ; Yang et al. (2023) ; Xin et al. (2024) ; Ren et al. (2025) ; Hubert et al. (2026) , and they can repair failed proofs using the prover’s error messages First et al. (2023) . Verifiable code generation asks for programs together with proofs of their correctness Aggarwal et al. (2025) ; Ye et al. (2026) . For example, Li et al. (2026) first generate a joint plan for the program and its proof, then elaborate both in Lean. LeanPlan specializes this idea to heuristic search, where every heuristic has the same proof obligations and where correctness alone is easy to achieve, since the heuristic that always returns zero is admissible. The agent must therefore also make the heuristic informative, which we measure by search on training tasks.

paragraphs.en: We introduced LeanPlan, a planner in which LLM coding agents develop domain-specific heuristics together with machine-checked proofs of their admissibility. For all domains considered, the agents produced such heuristics and proofs, so LLMs can help optimal planning without giving up the optimality guarantee. Requiring proofs did not force the agents to settle for weak heuristics: the proved heuristics exploit domain structure, and with them LeanPlan usually expands fewer states than the state-of-the-art optimal planner Scorpion and solves more tasks overall.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 LeanPlan，这是一种规划器，其中的 LLM 编码智能体能够共同开发领域特定的启发式方法，并生成机器验证的其可采纳性证明。 在所有所考虑的领域中，这些智能体都成功生成了此类启发式方法和证明，因此 LLM 可以在不牺牲最优性保证的前提下，辅助实现最优规划。 要求提供证明并未迫使智能体只能采用较弱的启发式方法：经过验证的启发式方法能够利用领域结构，借助它们，LeanPlan 通常比当前最先进的最优规划器 Scorpion 扩展更少的状态，并且总体上能解决更多任务。

paragraphs.en: LeanPlan supports only the unit-cost STRIPS fragment of PDDL, and our evaluation uses thirteen domains and a single LLM and coding-agent harness. The proofs guarantee admissibility only on tasks that satisfy the checked domain assumptions, and these assumptions can exclude test tasks, as in Cisterns. They do not certify unsolvability. The guarantees also rely on parts that the proofs do not check: Lean’s kernel, compiler and runtime, LeanPlan’s PDDL parser and the Lean definitions that formalize PDDL semantics. Extending the approach to action costs and richer PDDL fragments and evaluating other LLMs, including open-weight ones, remain open directions.

paragraphs.en: This work uses public planning benchmarks and three new benchmark domains (Appendix C ), and involves no human subjects or personal data. LeanPlan’s guarantees refer to the PDDL model, so an inaccurate model can still yield plans that are unsafe or suboptimal for the real system it describes. Developing each heuristic and proof requires LLM computation, but LeanPlan reuses every accepted heuristic on new tasks of its domain without further LLM calls.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究使用了公开的规划基准以及三个新的基准领域（附录 C），且未涉及任何人类受试者或个人数据。 LeanPlan 的保证针对的是 PDDL 模型，因此不准确的模型仍可能生成对于其所描述的真实系统而言不安全或非最优的计划。 开发每种启发式方法和证明都需要 LLM 的计算支持，但 LeanPlan 会在无需再次调用 LLM 的情况下，将每个已接受的启发式方法重新用于其领域内的新任务。

paragraphs.en: The listing replaces Lean’s implication glyph with its ASCII notation. The declaration structure ... : Prop defines a proposition with two proof fields, goalAware and consistent . Constructing a proof of ImprovedProof requires supplying a proof of each field. In each field, check = true -> introduces an assumption, and h.eval names the executable function whose property must be proved. The Boolean check is therefore an input to the proposition, not a proof term. At runtime, evaluating it establishes which tasks satisfy the theorem’s premise without reconstructing the proof. The flag rel selects whether grounding uses relevance pruning, and the domain theorems cover both values. Each of the thirteen domain files exports the theorem improved_proof_of_certificate , whose premise Validated d p requires both the domain and task validators to succeed. The theorem instantiates check with the domain certificate and h with the runtime evaluator: improved (ground d p rel) for IPC 2023 and Agent.heuristic (ground d p rel) for the new domains. The theorem ImprovedProof.admissible derives admissibility from these two fields and closure of reachability under transitions. The theorem covers every accepted task and every state reachable in that task.
paragraphs.zh: 该列表将 Lean 的蕴含符号替换为其 ASCII 表示法。 声明结构 ... : Prop 定义了一个命题，包含两个证明字段：goalAware 和 consistent。 构造 ImprovedProof 的证明需要提供每个字段的证明。 在每个字段中，check = true -> 会引入一个假设，而 h.eval 则指定了必须验证其属性的可执行函数。 因此，布尔值 check 是该命题的一个输入，而非证明项。 在运行时，对其求值可以确定哪些任务满足定理的前提，而无需重新构造证明。 标志位 rel 选择是否使用相关性修剪进行接地，且该域中的定理涵盖两种值。 十三个域文件中的每个文件都导出了定理 improved_proof_of_certificate，其前提 Validated d p 要求域和任务验证器均成功执行。 该定理将 check 实例化为域证书，h 实例化为运行时评估器：对于 IPC 2023，使用 improved (ground d p rel)；对于新域，使用 Agent.heuristic (ground d p rel)。 定理 ImprovedProof.admissible 从这两个字段以及可达性在状态转换下的封闭性推导出可接受性。 该定理涵盖了所有被接受的任务以及在这些任务中可达的所有状态。

paragraphs.en: In Proofs/Search/AStar.lean , astar_sound proves that any returned plan executes from the initial state to a goal. The theorem astar_optimal compares its cost with every valid plan of cost less than B = 2 40 B=2^{40} , assuming goal awareness and admissibility on an invariant containing the initial state. Taking that invariant to be reachability gives the statement in Section 3 . The proofs do not certify dead ends, because a pruned state has no plan that costs less than B B but may still have a more expensive one, even if a domain-specific dead-end test caused the pruning. When astar exhausts its open list, LeanPlan therefore reports that it found no plan rather than that the task is unsolvable. Because Lean can only reason about functions that provably terminate, astar takes an explicit iteration budget, its fuel, which is 2 62 2^{62} by default. Both theorems hold whenever the fuel suffices to return a plan, and exhausting it is reported as a failure. The separate theorem astar_terminates in Proofs/Search/Fuel.lean gives a sufficient completion bound for well-formed unit-cost tasks: fuel greater than N ⁡ ( N + 1 ) + 1 N(N+1)+1 , where N N counts all packed states satisfying State.WF t.numFacts .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Proofs/Search/AStar.lean 中，astar_sound 证明了任何返回的计划都能从初始状态执行到目标状态。 定理 astar_optimal 将其成本与所有成本小于 B = 2^{40} 的有效计划进行比较，假设在包含初始状态的不变量上具备目标感知性和可接纳性。 将该不变量设为可达性，即可得到第 3 节中的陈述。 这些证明并未认证死胡同，因为一个被剪枝的状态可能没有成本小于 B 的计划，但仍可能存在成本更高的计划，即使剪枝是由某个领域特定的死胡同检测引发的。 因此，当 astar 耗尽其开放列表时，LeanPlan 会报告未找到任何计划，而不是任务无法解决。 由于 Lean 只能对可证明终止的函数进行推理，astar 需要一个显式的迭代预算（即“燃料”），默认值为 2^{62}。 只要燃料足以返回一个计划，这两个定理就都成立；若燃料耗尽，则会被报告为失败。 Proofs/Search/Fuel.lean 中的独立定理 astar_terminates 为结构良好、单位成本的任务给出了一个充分的完成界限：燃料需大于 N(N+1)+1，其中 N 表示满足 State.WF t.numFacts 的所有打包状态的数量。

paragraphs.en: Orrery models the alignment of coupled wheels in a clockwork model of the solar system. Each wheel has K K discrete angular positions, and a twist advances one wheel by one position while retreating a coupled wheel by one position, modulo K K . The goal aligns every wheel with its reference mark using as few twists as possible. Every twist preserves the sum of wheel positions modulo K K , so correcting one wheel changes another and may require routing displacement through several couplings.

paragraphs.en: Cisterns models water redistribution through a network of hoses. paragraphs.en: Qubit Routing models the placement of logical qubits on a hardware coupling grid while executing an ordered sequence of two-qubit gates. paragraphs.en: For each block, compilation selects the first on goal naming it as the upper block and the first naming it as the lower block. These goals specify its selected support and the block it should carry, respectively. The goal-support chain follows the selected supports downwards. The heuristic marks blocks with an unmet selected on goal or on-table goal, held blocks and blocks standing on a support required to be clear or to carry a different selected block. It propagates these marks upwards through the current towers. Each marked block contributes one grab ( pickup or unstack ) and one placement ( putdown or stack ). The bound subtracts one grab if a marked block is already held and one placement if some marked block has no unmet support goal ( on or on-table ). The latter subtraction allows such a block to remain held in the relaxation. A marked block incurs a detour if its selected goal support is marked and the block is either held or standing on a block that belongs below it in the compiled goal-support chain. Such a block must be placed temporarily before it can reach its goal support, adding one grab and one placement. The heuristic takes the maximum of this action count and the number of unmet clear goals.

Here R R counts nonkitchen places whose waiting unserved goal children outnumber the sandwiches on trays currently there, plus one if L > 0 L>0 and no tray is in the kitchen. paragraphs.en: Each unmet car goal contributes three actions if the car is not aboard, two if it is aboard away from its destination and one if it is aboard and the ferry is at its destination. We call a car with an unmet goal waiting if it is not aboard, even when its location is unrecorded. Let W W contain the distinct recorded locations of waiting cars. The repositioning correction is zero if no car is waiting, if the emptiness test succeeds at a location in W W , or if the test fails and the carried car with an unmet goal has its destination in W W . It is one otherwise. The waiting-location correction counts locations in W W that are neither destinations of unmet car goals nor the current location of a ferry for which the emptiness test succeeds. Both corrections bound additional actions beyond the per-car counts, which can be paid by sailing or extra car handling. The heuristic adds the per-car counts and the maximum of these corrections. paragraphs.en: The heuristic adds the number of unmet painted goals, a color-change bound and a movement bound. The movement bound is the maximum of three quantities. The first takes, for each unmet painted goal, the minimum static-graph distance from any robot to any square from which the tile can be painted, then selects the largest distance. The second counts unattended tiles with unmet goals, which have no robot at a painting position, and divides by two, rounding up. One move can put a robot in position to paint at most two such tiles. The third counts distinct forced painting squares that no robot currently occupies. A goal tile has a forced painting square below it if that square exists and the upward chain consists entirely of goal tiles and ends at a tile with nothing above it. Since painting makes a tile impassable, these goal tiles must be painted from below, starting at the top. The color-change bound counts the distinct required colors held by no robot. With a single robot, it is the maximum of this count and a column bound. Starting at an unmet tile, the column bound follows the forced squares downwards through unmet tiles and counts each change of color between consecutive tiles, plus one if the robot does not hold the first color. The heuristic uses the largest column bound over all unmet tiles. The heuristic also searches the movement graph through clear and robot-occupied squares. It returns B B if an unmet tile’s forced painting square is unreachable, or, for a tile without a forced square, if none of its painting positions is reachable. Otherwise it returns the sum of the painting, color-change and movement bounds.
paragraphs.zh: 该启发式方法将未完成的涂色目标数量、颜色变化界限和移动界限相加。 移动界限是三个量中的最大值。 第一个量针对每个未完成的涂色目标，计算从任意机器人到可涂色方块所在格子的静态图最短距离，然后取最大的距离。 第二个量统计没有机器人处于涂色位置的未处理方块中未完成目标的数量，再除以二并向上取整。 一次移动最多能让机器人到达位置来涂色两个这样的方块。 第三个量统计当前没有机器人占据的不同强制涂色格子。 如果一个目标方块下方存在一个强制涂色格子，且该格子的向上路径完全由目标方块组成并终止于一个上方没有任何方块的格子，则这个目标方块具有一个强制涂色格子。 由于涂色会使方块变为不可通行，这些目标方块必须从下方开始涂色，且要从最顶部开始。 颜色变化界限统计了没有机器人持有的不同所需颜色数量。 对于单个机器人，该界限取这个颜色和列界限中的最大值。 从一个未完成方块出发，列界限沿着强制涂色格子向下穿过未完成方块，计算相邻方块之间的每次颜色变化，如果机器人不持有第一种颜色则再加一。 该启发式方法使用所有未完成方块中最大的列界限。 该启发式方法还会通过空着和机器人占据的格子搜索移动图。 如果一个未完成方块的强制涂色格子无法到达，或者对于没有强制涂色格子的方块，其所有涂色位置都无法到达，则返回 B B。 否则，它返回涂色界限、颜色变化界限和移动界限之和。

sents.en: The heuristic adds the number of unmet painted goals, a color-change bound and a movement bound.
sents.zh: 该启发式方法将未完成的涂色目标数量、颜色变化界限和移动界限相加。

sents.en: The movement bound is the maximum of three quantities.
sents.zh: 移动界限是三个量中的最大值。

sents.en: The first takes, for each unmet painted goal, the minimum static-graph distance from any robot to any square from which the tile can be painted, then selects the largest distance.
sents.zh: 第一个量针对每个未完成的涂色目标，计算从任意机器人到可涂色方块所在格子的静态图最短距离，然后取最大的距离。

sents.en: The second counts unattended tiles with unmet goals, which have no robot at a painting position, and divides by two, rounding up.
sents.zh: 第二个量统计没有机器人处于涂色位置的未处理方块中未完成目标的数量，再除以二并向上取整。

sents.en: One move can put a robot in position to paint at most two such tiles.
sents.zh: 一次移动最多能让机器人到达位置来涂色两个这样的方块。

sents.en: The third counts distinct forced painting squares that no robot currently occupies.
sents.zh: 第三个量统计当前没有机器人占据的不同强制涂色格子。

sents.en: A goal tile has a forced painting square below it if that square exists and the upward chain consists entirely of goal tiles and ends at a tile with nothing above it.
sents.zh: 如果一个目标方块下方存在一个强制涂色格子，且该格子的向上路径完全由目标方块组成并终止于一个上方没有任何方块的格子，则这个目标方块具有一个强制涂色格子。

sents.en: Since painting makes a tile impassable, these goal tiles must be painted from below, starting at the top.
sents.zh: 由于涂色会使方块变为不可通行，这些目标方块必须从下方开始涂色，且要从最顶部开始。

sents.en: The color-change bound counts the distinct required colors held by no robot.
sents.zh: 颜色变化界限统计了没有机器人持有的不同所需颜色数量。

sents.en: With a single robot, it is the maximum of this count and a column bound.
sents.zh: 对于单个机器人，该界限取这个颜色和列界限中的最大值。

sents.en: Starting at an unmet tile, the column bound follows the forced squares downwards through unmet tiles and counts each change of color between consecutive tiles, plus one if the robot does not hold the first color.
sents.zh: 从一个未完成方块出发，列界限沿着强制涂色格子向下穿过未完成方块，计算相邻方块之间的每次颜色变化，如果机器人不持有第一种颜色则再加一。

sents.en: The heuristic uses the largest column bound over all unmet tiles.
sents.zh: 该启发式方法使用所有未完成方块中最大的列界限。

sents.en: The heuristic also searches the movement graph through clear and robot-occupied squares.
sents.zh: 该启发式方法还会通过空着和机器人占据的格子搜索移动图。

sents.en: It returns B B if an unmet tile’s forced painting square is unreachable, or, for a tile without a forced square, if none of its painting positions is reachable.
sents.zh: 如果一个未完成方块的强制涂色格子无法到达，或者对于没有强制涂色格子的方块，其所有涂色位置都无法到达，则返回 B B。

sents.en: Otherwise it returns the sum of the painting, color-change and movement bounds.
sents.zh: 否则，它返回涂色界限、颜色变化界限和移动界限之和。

paragraphs.en: The heuristic counts one communication per unmet data goal, one sample per missing soil or rock analysis and one image-taking action per missing image. An analysis or image is missing only if no rover already holds it. Each image-taking action consumes a calibration, so the calibration shortfall is the number of required image-taking actions minus the number of currently true calibrated atoms, truncated at zero. Similarly, the empty-store shortfall is the number of required samples minus the number of currently true empty atoms, truncated at zero. The travel bound is the largest distance to a required sampling waypoint from its nearest suitably equipped rover, using each rover’s traversal-and-visibility graph. Rovers without recorded locations are omitted, and a minimum with no located suitable rover is zero. A second navigation bound counts distinct required sampling waypoints that no rover currently occupies. The heuristic adds the five action counts to the maximum of the two navigation bounds. Communication, sampling, imaging, calibration, emptying stores and navigation use separate actions.
paragraphs.zh: 该启发式方法将每个未达成的数据目标计为一次通信，每次缺失的土壤或岩石分析计为一次采样，以及每次缺失的图像计为一次图像采集操作。 只有当没有探测车已持有某项分析结果或图像时，该项分析或图像才被视为缺失。 每次图像采集操作都会消耗一次校准，因此校准缺口等于所需图像采集操作次数减去当前有效校准原子的数量，且结果取零的上界。 类似地，空存储缺口等于所需采样次数减去当前有效空原子数量的结果，且取零的上界。 移动界限是指从最近的具备适当装备的探测车出发，到某个必要采样路径点的最长距离，该距离基于各探测车的移动与可见性图计算得出。 未记录位置的探测车将被忽略；若无任何已定位的合适探测车，则最小值为零。 第二个导航界限统计的是当前没有探测车占据的各个必要采样路径点的数量。 该启发式方法将上述五种操作次数与两个导航界限中的较大值相加。 通信、采样、成像、校准、清空存储和导航各自使用独立的操作。

paragraphs.en: Each unmet have_image or pointing goal contributes one. The heuristic adds the following five bounds to these counts. An instrument is ready if it is both powered and calibrated. The calibration bound considers modes needed by unmet image goals that no ready instrument supports. It is zero if no mode remains, one if a single instrument supports all remaining modes and two otherwise. The power-on bound first removes modes supported by a powered instrument, then applies the same rule to the remaining modes, considering all instruments for the cover. For each unmet image, we omit its direction if an unmet pointing goal already names it. We also omit it if a satellite points there with an instrument that supports the image’s mode and is either ready or has that direction as its calibration target. The image-direction bound counts distinct directions of the remaining images. For the remaining terms, a candidate is any instrument that supports a mode needed by an unmet image goal. The calibration-approach bound is zero if no calibration is needed. It is also zero if any candidate has an unknown carrier or target, its carrier is already at its target, or its target occurs among the unmet pointing-goal directions or additional image directions. Otherwise it is one. The power-slot-release bound is one if some needed mode has no powered instrument and every candidate has a known carrier with a recorded, currently false power_avail atom. Otherwise it is zero.
paragraphs.zh: 每个未满足的 have_image 或指向目标都会贡献一个计数。 启发式方法会向这些计数添加以下五个界限。 如果某个仪器既已供电又已完成校准，则视为就绪。 校准界限会考虑那些未被任何就绪仪器支持的、未满足图像目标所需的模式。 如果没有剩余模式，该界限为零；如果只有一个仪器支持所有剩余模式，则为1；否则为2。 开机界限首先移除已供电仪器所支持的模式，然后对剩余模式应用相同规则，并在覆盖选择时考虑所有仪器。 对于每个未满足的图像，如果某个未满足的指向目标已经指定了该图像的方向，则我们省略其方向。 如果某颗卫星使用一个支持该图像模式且已就绪或将其方向作为校准目标的仪器指向该方向，我们也会省略该方向。 图像-方向界限会统计剩余图像的不同方向数量。 对于其余项，候选仪器是指任何支持未满足图像目标所需模式的仪器。 如果不需要进行校准，则校准-接近界限为零。 如果任何候选仪器的载体或目标未知、其载体已到达目标、或其目标出现在未满足的指向目标方向或额外的图像方向中，该界限也为零；否则为1。 如果某个所需模式没有已供电的仪器，且所有候选仪器的已知载体都记录了一个当前为假的 power_avail 原子，则电源槽释放界限为1；否则为零。

paragraphs.en: The implementation permits several workers. Let G G contain the goal nuts with a recorded initial location. The compiled heuristic omits other goal nuts because nut positions never change and an unlocated nut cannot be tightened. The movement bound D ⁡ ( s ) D(s) is the directed-link distance from the closest worker to the gate. The implementation computes it as the largest such distance to the location of a nut in G G with an unmet tightened goal, which is the gate in every IPC 2023 task, and it is zero if no such nut exists. Workers without a recorded location are omitted from the minimum over workers, which equals the distance-table cap if no recorded worker location remains. paragraphs.en: The static succ atoms order the gates in a chain that ends at the goal gate. For each gate, compilation records the number of gates from it up to the goal gate, each of which requires one execute action. The heuristic adds this count for the active gate to a bound on the remaining swaps. The deficit of a gate is the distance between the nodes of its two qubits in the coupling graph minus one, which is zero if the qubits are adjacent. A swap moves two qubits by one edge each, so it reduces the deficit of any gate by at most one, and the largest deficit among the remaining gates is a lower bound on the number of swaps. If several remaining gates have pairwise disjoint qubits, a swap moves at most two of their qubits and reduces their summed deficits by at most two, so half this sum, rounded up, is also a lower bound. Compilation fixes 2 ​ m 2m such sets for the m m gates of the chain by greedy maximal matching, scanning the gates in each of the m m rotations of the chain order, forward and backward. In each state, the heuristic restricts these sets to the remaining gates. The swap bound is the maximum of the largest deficit and the matching bounds. Since executing a gate requires adjacent qubits, it removes a gate with zero deficit and reduces the heuristic by exactly one.
paragraphs.zh: 静态的 succ 原子将门排列成一条链，该链以目标门为终点。 对于每个门，编译会记录从该门到目标门之间的门的数量，其中每个门都需要一次执行操作。 启发式方法将此活跃门的计数加到剩余交换操作的界上。 一个门的赤字是耦合图中其两个量子比特节点之间的距离减一；如果这两个量子比特相邻，则赤字为零。 一次交换使两个量子比特各移动一条边，因此它最多只能将任何门的赤字减少一，而剩余门中的最大赤字是交换操作数量的一个下界。 如果多个剩余门的量子比特互不相交，则一次交换最多只能移动其中两个量子比特，并将它们的赤字总和最多减少二，因此该总和的一半向上取整也是一个下界。 编译通过贪心最大匹配为链中的 m 个门固定了 2m 个这样的集合，扫描链顺序在 m 种旋转下的每个门的正向和反向排列。 在每个状态下，启发式方法将这些集合限制在剩余的门上。 交换界是最大赤字与匹配界中的较大者。 由于执行一个门需要相邻的量子比特，因此它会移除一个赤字为零的门，并使启发式值恰好减少一。

sents.en: The heuristic adds this count for the active gate to a bound on the remaining swaps.
sents.zh: 启发式方法将此活跃门的计数加到剩余交换操作的界上。

sents.en: The deficit of a gate is the distance between the nodes of its two qubits in the coupling graph minus one, which is zero if the qubits are adjacent.
sents.zh: 一个门的赤字是耦合图中其两个量子比特节点之间的距离减一；如果这两个量子比特相邻，则赤字为零。

sents.en: A swap moves two qubits by one edge each, so it reduces the deficit of any gate by at most one, and the largest deficit among the remaining gates is a lower bound on the number of swaps.
sents.zh: 一次交换使两个量子比特各移动一条边，因此它最多只能将任何门的赤字减少一，而剩余门中的最大赤字是交换操作数量的一个下界。

sents.en: If several remaining gates have pairwise disjoint qubits, a swap moves at most two of their qubits and reduces their summed deficits by at most two, so half this sum, rounded up, is also a lower bound.
sents.zh: 如果多个剩余门的量子比特互不相交，则一次交换最多只能移动其中两个量子比特，并将它们的赤字总和最多减少二，因此该总和的一半向上取整也是一个下界。

sents.en: Compilation fixes 2 ​ m 2m such sets for the m m gates of the chain by greedy maximal matching, scanning the gates in each of the m m rotations of the chain order, forward and backward.
sents.zh: 编译通过贪心最大匹配为链中的 m 个门固定了 2m 个这样的集合，扫描链顺序在 m 种旋转下的每个门的正向和反向排列。

sents.en: In each state, the heuristic restricts these sets to the remaining gates.
sents.zh: 在每个状态下，启发式方法将这些集合限制在剩余的门上。

sents.en: The swap bound is the maximum of the largest deficit and the matching bounds.
sents.zh: 交换界是最大赤字与匹配界中的较大者。

sents.en: Since executing a gate requires adjacent qubits, it removes a gate with zero deficit and reduces the heuristic by exactly one.
sents.zh: 由于执行一个门需要相邻的量子比特，因此它会移除一个赤字为零的门，并使启发式值恰好减少一。

paragraphs.en: The following certificate conditions delimit the supported task classes. They apply in addition to ordinary validation and exact equality of the action-schema list with the generated domain. An exact type requires each object that inhabits that type through subtyping to declare that precise type. The initial-state checks establish the premises whose dynamic components the domain proofs preserve. Static-predicate checks ensure that the atoms in their static components cannot change. A dynamic goal uses a predicate that an action schema can change. These are task acceptance conditions, distinct from the zero-table fallback used by distance computations. The definitions are in each domain’s Certificate.lean file.
paragraphs.zh: 以下证书条件界定了所支持的任务类别。 这些条件在常规验证以及动作模式列表与生成域完全一致的情况下额外适用。 精确类型要求每个通过子类型继承该类型的对象都必须声明该精确类型。 初始状态检查确立了动态组件由域证明所保留的前提条件。 静态谓词检查确保其静态组件中的原子不可更改。 动态目标使用一个可以被动作模式更改的谓词。 这些是任务接受条件，与距离计算中使用的零表回退机制不同。 相关定义位于每个域的 Certificate.lean 文件中。

paragraphs.en: The certificate requires a declared object type, at least one object and duplicate-free goals. Each on goal has two arguments, but goals need not consist only of on atoms. Initially, each block has at most one support and supports at most one block. At most one block is held, and arm-empty holds exactly when none is held. A held block neither stands on nor supports a block and is neither on the table nor clear. A block standing on another is not on the table, and a clear block supports nothing. Following initial supports must terminate within the number of on atoms plus one. The checks establish unambiguous acyclic towers without requiring complete block locations.
paragraphs.zh: 该证书需要一个声明的对象类型、至少一个对象以及无重复的目标。 每个 on 目标都有两个参数，但目标不必仅由 on 原子组成。 初始时，每个块最多有一个支撑物，且最多支撑一个块。 最多只有一个块被持有，且 arm-empty 为真当且仅当没有块被持有。 一个被持有的块既不在另一个块上，也不支撑任何块，并且既不在桌子上，也不是空的。 一个站在另一个块上的块不在桌子上，而一个空的块不支撑任何东西。 初始支撑关系必须在 on 原子的数量加一之内终止。 这些检查能够建立无歧义的无环塔状结构，而无需知道所有块的完整位置。

paragraphs.en: The sandwich, tray, place, child, bread-portion and content-portion types must be declared, and sandwich, tray and place types must be exact. At least one tray and sandwich and a place named kitchen must exist. Goals form a nonempty, duplicate-free list of served atoms naming children declared with type child . Each goal child has a waiting place and an allergy classification. Waiting places are unique per child and typed, and allergic and nonallergic classifications are disjoint. Both classification predicates and waiting are static. Initially, each tray occupies at most one place, each sandwich belongs to at most one tray, and kitchen and tray membership are disjoint. Nonexistent sandwiches are in neither location and cannot be gluten-free. No sandwich is initially gluten-free. Tray-location existence is not required. These checks support distinct resource counts and preserved sandwich and tray invariants.

paragraphs.en: Car and location types must be declared and exact, with at least one object of each. Every car has exactly one at goal naming a typed location. The extracted car–destination pairs and their car names are duplicate-free, but other goal predicates are not excluded. Initially, the ferry has at most one location, each car has at most one ashore location, and at most one car is aboard. An aboard car has no ashore location. An empty-ferry atom implies that no car is aboard, without requiring the converse. Initial location existence is not required. These conditions establish the capacity-one invariant used by the per-car sailing bound.

paragraphs.en: Tile, robot and color types are exact. Goals are duplicate-free, name each painted tile once and exclude grid edges. Grid predicates are static. Initially, each robot has at most one position and color, and each tile has at most one robot. Occupied tiles are neither clear nor painted, and clear tiles are unpainted. The certificate grounds both relevance settings and checks each compiled task. Up/down edges have arity two, up is functional and inverse-functional, and each down edge reverses an up edge. Compiled painted goals have known colors and unique tile entries, and present clear-atom indices match their tiles. For N N compiled tile entries and distance cap D bound D_{\mathrm{bound}} , the certificate requires 2 ​ N + max ⁡ ( D bound , N ) ≤ B 2N+\max(D_{\mathrm{bound}},N)\leq B . Neither robot-position existence nor complete rectangular topology is required.
paragraphs.zh: 瓷砖、机器人和颜色类型均完全一致。 目标无重复，每个已涂色的瓷砖仅命名一次，且不计入网格边缘。 网格谓词是静态的。 初始时，每个机器人最多只有一个位置和一种颜色，且每个瓷砖上最多只有一个机器人。 被占用的瓷砖既非空也非已涂色，而空瓷砖则未涂色。 证书同时为相关性设置提供依据，并检查每个编译后的任务。 上下边缘具有二元性，上边缘是函数性的且具有逆函数性，每个下边缘则反转一个上边缘。 已编译的涂色目标具有已知颜色和唯一的瓷砖条目，且其空原子索引与对应瓷砖匹配。 对于 N 个已编译的瓷砖条目和距离上限 D，证书要求满足 2N+\max(D_{\mathrm{bound}},N)\leq B。 既不需要机器人位置的存在性，也不需要完整的矩形拓扑结构。

Goals are a nonempty list of served atoms naming distinct passengers declared with type passenger . Destinations are static, unique per passenger, typed as floors and present for every goal passenger. The initial invariant checks at most one lift floor and at most one origin per passenger. These multiplicity checks do not require that either location exists.

paragraphs.en: Rover, waypoint, store, camera, mode, lander and objective types must be declared, and rover and waypoint types must be exact. Goals are duplicate-free and dynamic, but need not be communication goals. The heuristic compiles only the three communicated-data goal predicates. Each rover initially has at most one position, without requiring one to exist. Traversal, visibility and soil/rock equipment predicates must be static. Traversal self-loops are forbidden. Every traversal edge also present in visible must have reverse traversal and visibility atoms. The per-rover graphs intersect traversal and visibility. There are no additional explicit type-disjointness, store/camera assignment-multiplicity or task-size conditions. Graph distances use node-count caps and checked zero-table fallback.

paragraphs.en: Every compiled goal names a task goal and a mark of the cycle. Every ground action adds marks of at most two goal wheels, and each added mark is one cycle step away from a mark of the same wheel in the action’s precondition. The certificate imposes no initial-state conditions, since the heuristic takes the closest of a wheel’s marks.
paragraphs.zh: 每个编译后的目标都命名了一个任务目标，并标记了循环。 每个具体行动最多会添加两个目标轮的标记，且每个新增的标记与同一轮在该行动前提条件中的标记仅相差一个循环步骤。 该证书不施加任何初始状态条件，因为启发式方法会选择某个轮上最近的标记。

paragraphs.en: Every compiled goal names a task goal and a level of the level graph, and the level atoms of each goal tank are distinct. Each goal tank has exactly one initial level, and every ground action preserves the mutual exclusion of its level atoms. Every ground action either leaves a goal tank unchanged or replaces the level in its precondition by one new level. Demands number the levels in the order of the task’s level objects, and each action reduces every demand by at most one. Each action reduces every compiled set sum by at most its cost and changes every potential bound by at most its cost.
paragraphs.zh: 每个编译后的目标都指定了一个任务目标和层级图中的某个层级，并且每个目标罐的层级原子都是互不相同的。 每个目标罐恰好有一个初始层级，并且每个基础动作都会保持其层级原子的互斥性。 每个基础动作要么使一个目标罐保持不变，要么将其前提条件中的层级替换为一个新的层级。 需求按照任务中层级对象的出现顺序对各个层级进行编号，并且每个动作最多使每个需求的值减少一。 每个动作最多使每个编译后的集合和减少其成本值，并最多使每个潜在界限改变其成本值。

paragraphs.en: The goal is a single active atom whose gate ends the compiled chain, and the two qubits of each gate differ. Exactly one gate is initially active, and every ground action preserves the mutual exclusion of the active atoms. Likewise, each qubit initially occupies exactly one node, and every ground action preserves the mutual exclusion of its position atoms. An action that changes the active gate activates its successor, moves no qubit and requires the qubits of the executed gate to be at distance at most one. Every action moves at most two qubits, and the gates of each compiled matching have pairwise disjoint qubits. For every gate, each action reduces the deficit by at most one and by at most the number of the gate’s qubits that it moves.
paragraphs.zh: 目标是一个单一的活跃原子，其门结束编译后的链，并且每个门的两个量子比特各不相同。 初始时恰好有一个门是活跃的，并且每个基础操作都保持活跃原子的互斥性。 同样地，每个量子比特初始时占据恰好一个节点，并且每个基础操作都保持其位置原子的互斥性。 改变活跃门的操作会激活其后续门，不移动任何量子比特，并要求已执行门的量子比特之间的距离最多为1。 每个操作最多移动两个量子比特，并且每个编译匹配中的门对应的量子比特两两不相交。 对于每个门，每次操作最多将赤字减少1，且最多减少该门被移动的量子比特的数量。

paragraphs.en: The shared graph-distance check verifies table dimension bounds, bounded entries, a zero diagonal, edge consistency and a cap at least as large as the node count. It also checks the following property for every edge from u u to v v and every target t t : if the entry from v v to t t is below the cap, then the entry from u u to t t is also below the cap. Sokoban’s product check requires n 2 n^{2} entries, zero at valid goal configurations, bounded entries, edge consistency and the same backward-propagation property. These checks connect the finite tables to the distance properties used by the domain proofs. Failure selects zero tables during compilation rather than rejecting the task.
paragraphs.zh: 共享图距离检查验证了表维度界限、有界条目、零对角线、边一致性，以及一个至少与节点数量相等或更大的上限。 它还为从 u 到 v 的每条边和每个目标 t 检查以下性质：如果从 v 到 t 的条目低于上限，那么从 u 到 t 的条目也低于上限。 Sokoban 的乘积检查需要 n² 个条目，在有效目标配置中为零，且满足有界条目、边一致性和相同的反向传播性质。 这些检查将有限表与领域证明中使用的距离性质连接起来。 如果检查失败，编译时会选择零个表，而不是拒绝该任务。

paragraphs.en: The dataset contains all 8 550 recorded configuration–task runs, including the 5 850 runs of the five configurations reported here, with coverage, cost, search and total time, expansions, resource limits, certificate flags and whether expansions came from an interrupted run’s checkpoint. The IPC 2023 snapshot contains 7 200 runs, and a separate snapshot adds 1 350 runs on the new domains, retaining their original algorithm identifiers. Every reported configuration has a run for each of the 90 test tasks per domain, and all 1 157 solved runs of the reported configurations carry expansion measurements from completed runs. We exclude checkpoint counts from the expansion comparisons.

paragraphs.en: For LeanPlan, total time is wall-clock time from before PDDL reading through search, covering validation, grounding, h 2 h^{2} pruning and heuristic setup, and excluding plan output and external VAL checking. Search time runs from the end of grounding and h 2 h^{2} pruning until search returns, including certificate checking and heuristic setup. LeanPlan counts a state as expanded when it generates its successors, excluding stale queue entries and the popped goal. Each planner reports expansions under its own definition.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 LeanPlan，总时间是指从 PDDL 读取前开始到搜索结束所经历的墙钟时间，涵盖验证、落地处理、h² 剪枝和启发式设置，但不包括计划输出和外部 VAL 检查。 搜索时间从落地处理和 h² 剪枝结束之时开始，直到搜索返回为止，包括证书检查和启发式设置。 LeanPlan 在状态生成其后继状态时将其计为已展开，但排除队列中的陈旧条目以及被弹出的目标状态。 每个规划器均按照其自身定义报告展开次数。
